title: Lake Austin Boat Cruise 1.5 Hour Scenic Tour BYOB Per Person
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children 13 and under must be accompanied by an adult
policies: Boat Travel time is included in the total trip duration.
Parking is extremely Limited, ride share/uber is highly recommended.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Best Cruise on Lake Austin! This 1.5 -hour BYOB boat tour offers stunning views while cruising past Mount Bonnell, Pennybacker Bridge, and Austin’s most exclusive waterfront homes. 

Unmatched Views & Live Music – Experience the lake, passing Ski Shores Café, where live music enhances the evening ambiance.

BYOB & Bluetooth-Enabled Fun – Bring your favorite drinks, relax in cushioned seating, and play your own music with Bluetooth or AUX connection. A cooler, ice, and water are provided.

‍Hassle-Free & Fully Captained – Your licensed captain takes care of everything so you can sit back and enjoy this must-do Austin experience, perfect for couples, groups, and first-time visitors!
